name: nds_sound
statement: The ARM7's sixteen sound channels (0x04000400 + 16 n: SOUNDxCNT, SOUNDxSAD, SOUNDxTMR, SOUNDxPNT, SOUNDxLEN), SOUNDCNT, SOUNDBIAS and the two capture units, as far as a game can see them: a channel's busy bit (SOUNDxCNT bit 31) stays set while it plays, a one-shot channel stops when its samples would have played out, a looping, manual, PSG or noise channel plays until it is stopped, and a one-shot capture stops when its buffer would be full. No samples are mixed yet: there is no audio output.

registers.name: SOUNDxCNT
registers.bits: 0-6 volume, 8-9 divider, 15 hold, 16-22 panning, 24-26 PSG duty, 27-28 repeat (0 manual, 1 loop, 2 one-shot), 29-30 format (0 PCM8, 1 PCM16, 2 IMA-ADPCM, 3 PSG/noise), 31 start/busy

registers.name: SOUNDxTMR (sample period: 0x10000 - TMR ticks of 16.756991 MHz)
SNDCAP0CNT, SNDCAP1CNT (bit 2 one-shot, bit 3 PCM8, bit 7 start/busy)

limits: no mixing and no audio output; the busy bits follow from the sample counts and rates (a channel's hold bit and the capture's addition modes change nothing)
